name: Conceiving A Baby
overview: Scripture reveals that conceiving a baby is a divine blessing and part of God's design for humanity, as He commands mankind to be fruitful and multiply to replenish the earth (Genesis 1:28). Children are described as a heritage from the Lord and a reward from the fruit of the womb (Psalms 127:3), emphasizing the sacredness of life and family. God’s provision includes the promise that nothing in the land shall be barren (Exodus 23:26), highlighting His power over fertility. Additionally, the miraculous conception of Immanuel foretold in Isaiah 7:14 underscores God's sovereign involvement in the gift of life.
